notWitnessed.why: whether a deliverable is filled is judged against the package's templates (placeholders, divergence floor); the witness carries each deliverable's digest and the state the verdict read, not the template comparison

whether a rule's text is one runward published, and which rules the package ships, are read from the installed package (templates/rule-history.json, templates/rules/); the witness pins their digests and does not carry them
a signed rule's evidence is matched against its `signature:` regex over the cited text outside the manifest; the witness says which rules are signed, not the match
the result of a symbol read through a SARIF, ESLint, CycloneDX, load-test or coverage report; the witness carries the nature and the result the verdict read, not the facts behind it
whether a pointer's spelling matches the case the file system holds (a case-insensitive checkout); the verdict's spelling ladder is not witnessed
whether a cited file is still byte for byte a file runward scaffolded; the comparison set comes from the package and the lock
a cited file that exists and cannot be read; the witness records no digest for it
the evidence seal (evidence-lock.json) and its drift
the delegation charter, the sample ledger (ADR-0088) and the assurance mode read from them (`delegation.assurance`, ADR-0090, ADR-0095)
the operator's hooks; their failures are an input to the verdict, never re-checkable from the tree
readings that never count: the ratification ledger and its per-row list (`ratification.byRow`, ADR-0095), unmet evidence natures (`requires:`), the critical-scope disclosure
